brief: Draw a block figure titled "Certificate renewal automation". A scheduler triggers a renewal job on a timer. The renewal job asks a CA client to obtain a new certificate. The CA client talks to the certificate authority itself to get the new certificate. Once the renewal job has the new certificate, it hands off to a deploy agent, which restarts the affected service to pick up the new certificate. Use these ids: scheduler, renewaljob, caclient, ca, deployagent, service. Show the five connections the description implies: scheduler into renewaljob, renewaljob into caclient, caclient into ca, renewaljob into deployagent, and deployagent into service.
